name: danielcz.xyz
description: Personal research portfolio of Daniel Campos Zamora, built with Astro and deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.check:ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run content && npm run build && npm run budget
scripts.check: npm run check:ci && npm run test:e2e && npm run lighthouse
scripts.lighthouse: lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.cjs && lhci autorun --config=lighthouserc.dark.cjs && node scripts/lighthouse-report.mjs
scripts.launch-check: npm run check && node scripts/content-report.mjs --strict && SITE_URL=https://dcz-xyz.github.io BASE_PATH=/danielcz.xyz/ npm run build && node scripts/staging-smoke.mjs && npm run build
